summary: Partners banned from the Dub Partner Network can no longer get payouts re-enabled: payout-state recomputation (used by Stripe Connect / payout-method webhooks) keeps payoutsEnabledAt null for banned partners, and connecting a Tremendous payout method via the referrals embed is refused with a 403 for them.

statements.why: No new risk is introduced; the change tightens who can be paid.

statements.text: The agent changed verify-otp/route.ts, recipient-account-closed.ts, recipient-configuration-updated.ts, account-application-deauthorized.ts, account-updated.ts and recompute-partner-payout-state.ts in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: True but gives no meaning, despite this being a payments change.

misses.what: Money rule change: partners banned from the network now stay with payouts disabled even if they reconnect Stripe/PayPal/stablecoin payout methods (recompute-partner-payout-state.ts:130).
Banned partners trying to connect a Tremendous payout method in the referrals embed now get an error 'Your account is banned from the Dub Partner Network...'.
